problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must allocate shipments onto identical cargo planes. Shipments:
* Component Alpha: mass 41 tonnes
* Component Beta: mass 50 tonnes
* Component Gamma: mass 55 tonnes
* Component Delta: mass 48 tonnes
* Component Epsilon: mass 52 tonnes
* Component Zeta: mass 58 tonnes
* Component Eta: mass 60 tonnes
* Component Theta: mass 56 tonnes
* Component Iota: mass 41 tonnes
* Component Kappa: mass 68 tonnes
* Component Lambda: mass 59 tonnes
* Component Mu: mass 43 tonnes
* Component Nu: mass 46 tonnes
* Component Xi: mass 56 tonnes
* Component Omicron: mass 57 tonnes
* Component Pi: mass 61 tonnes
* Component Rho: mass 33 tonnes
* Component Sigma: mass 51 tonnes
* Component Tau: mass 61 tonnes
* Component Upsilon: mass 51 tonnes
* Component Phi: mass 70 tonnes
* Component Chi: mass 33 tonnes
* Component Psi: mass 50 tonnes
* Component Omega: mass 61 tonnes
* Component Asterisk: mass 53 tonnes
* Component Ampersand: mass 70 tonnes
* Component BraceLeft: mass 58 tonnes
* Component Backslash: mass 34 tonnes
* Component BracketRight: mass 35 tonnes
* Component Caret: mass 64 tonnes
* Component Underscore: mass 48 tonnes
* Component Grave: mass 48 tonnes
* Component aa: mass 69 tonnes
* Component bb: mass 57 tonnes
* Component cc: mass 51 tonnes
* Component dd: mass 59 tonnes
* Component ee: mass 37 tonnes

Each cargo plane can carry a maximum load of 100 tonnes. Assign all shipments to planes while minimizing the total number of planes used. Every shipment must be placed on exactly one plane, and the combined mass on any plane must not surpass its capacity.
